name: Familial Progressive Retinal Dystrophy-Iris Coloboma-Congenital Cataract Syndrome
aliases: Familial Retinal Dystrophy with Iris Coloboma and Congenital Cataract

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Familial Progressive Retinal Dystrophy-Iris Coloboma-Congenital Cataract Syndrome

criteria.description: Progressive retinal dystrophy evidenced by fundoscopic examination and visual field testing
Presence of iris coloboma confirmed by slit-lamp biomicroscopy
Bilateral congenital cataracts identified on ophthalmologic examination
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance
Abnormal electroretinography (ERG) showing reduced retinal function

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: progressive retinal dystrophy, iris coloboma, and congenital cataract
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not mandatory

searchTerms: progressive vision loss from retina damage
gradual loss of sight due to retina

pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic keyhole-shaped defect in the iris
Present at birth causing lens opacity

common.notes: Involuntary eye movements due to visual impairment
Light sensitivity secondary to iris defects
Progressive decrease in sharpness of vision
Tunnel vision due to retinal dystrophy

occasional.notes: Secondary glaucoma due to structural eye abnormalities
Corneal clouding possibly related to ocular anomalies

rare.notes: Separation of retina from underlying tissue

imaging: Fundus photography showing retinal dystrophy and pigmentary changes
Optical coherence tomography (OCT) demonstrating retinal layer thinning
Ultrasound biomicroscopy confirming iris coloboma and lens abnormalities
other: Electroretinography (ERG) showing reduced or absent retinal responses
Visual field testing revealing constricted fields

distinguishingFeatures: Coloboma may be present but without progressive retinal dystrophy

redFlags: Rapidly progressive vision loss in early childhood
Presence of iris coloboma with congenital cataract
Family history of similar ocular abnormalities
references: Orphanet: Familial Progressive Retinal Dystrophy-Iris Coloboma-Congenital Cataract Syndrome, ORPHA:488197
